descriptions.normal: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. The meaty, herby aroma really gets your appetite going.
descriptions.suspicious: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. A bit chewy and annoyingly sticks to your teeth.
descriptions.delicious: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. The beautiful, authentic flavors take you on a culinary adventure from the first bite to the last.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 18% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.
